scope: 2026-10-03 F16 candidate-selection visualization through latest saved completed observed-discrepancy experiment on 2026-10-05

claims.claim_text: Visualization separated candidate coverage from selection and independent ADE/FDE minima from complete-path quality.
Human observations motivate late-path, endpoint, continuity and diversity checks, but are not representative overall or psychological-intent evidence.
Frozen feature probes read some event risk; unreadability or absent rules do not prove unpredictability.
Cue-compatible failures often have coarse candidate responses without adequate full paths.
GT-assisted curves provide high expression-witness coverage but not past-only predictive accuracy or all-motion-gate feasibility.
Original objective rewards good replacements in inspected groups while winner feedback is locally sparse; this does not prove a loss-only root cause.
Small-head diagnostic learns some FIT failures but does not improve full CAL coverage.
Five completed formal newhead comparisons give limited gains and no major; state availability improves some coverage, centered representation does not.
Current method is a frozen F16 native K20 plus candidate-observation conditioned bounded persistent-increment correction; scorer is unchanged.
Next normalization comparison is design pending, not running or completed, in saved runtime.
Engineering preserves failed provenance, old SHA, bounded memory and exact training resume checks, distinct from model success.

manifest_negative_constraints: No new training or process polling during report creation.
No SOTA, independent generalization, psychological intent, decoder-only or loss-only causal conclusion.
No treating independent minADE/minFDE as a single good candidate.
No adding repeated seeds or overlapping windows as independent people.
No interpreting inherited native slots as rescored new probabilities.
No treating GT-assisted expression witnesses as deployment performance.
No treating frozen-data diagnostics as formal model experiments.

review_disclosure: Source verification and counterchecks are performed inline by the same assistant, not external independent peer review.
